text:
```yaml
name: Publish Remote Config

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *' # Daily at 1 AM UTC

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run Ruff checks
      run: uvx ruff check --select I .

    - name: Run Ruff formatting check
      run: uvx ruff format --check .

    - name: Run Pyright type checker
      run: uv run pyright .

    - name: Run tests
      run: uv run python3 -m pytest --benchmark-quiet -q .

    - name: Serialize remote config
      run: |
        python scripts/serialize_config.py > remote_config.json

    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./remote_config
        publish_branch: gh-pages
        cname: kiln.ai
```
